method: Visual comparison in the browser of each vendor CSS animation at 20%, 80% and 102% of its duration, against every cumulative candidate with start/end markers; repeated after corrections.

visualReview.finalClearanceAdjustment: The exact segment-distance check found a small stroke 1/3 overlap after the first visual pass. Stroke 1 was adjusted, then its direction and the completed 14-stroke candidate were visually checked again.

limits: Direction, continuity and component connections were reviewed. The runtime is a local centerline drawing, not an exact copy of the vendor's brush outline. Earlier Vivasam video observations are corroborating records, not a new video review in this batch.
